title: Rowdy Rakshak
desc: A special agent is assigned to protect the prime minister, who later gets assassinated. He is tasked with finding the group responsible for the assassination.

title: Shaadi Mein Zaroor Aana
desc: Satyendra and Aarti meet for an arranged marriage and end up falling in love with each other. Their lives, however, change completely when she runs away on their wedding day.

title: Ek Vivah Aisa Bhi
desc: Holding their love in his heart for years, Prem waits for the day when Chandni can come back to him.

title: Dream Girl
desc: A man lands a call center job by mimicking a woman's voice, gaining fame and a loyal fan base. However, his double life spirals out of control when rabid clients overstep boundaries.

title: RRR
desc: A fearless revolutionary and an officer in the British force, both of whom once shared a deep bond, decide to join forces against despotic rulers.

title: Commando - A One Man Army
desc: Caught in the diplomatic crossfire between India and China, Captain Karan Dogra fights a harrowing battle for survival and makes a new enemy by rescuing a damsel in distress.

title: Udta Punjab
desc: A rock star, doctor, cop, and labourer battle the chaos of Punjab's drug crisis, each fighting demons as addiction and crime threaten to consume everything.

title: Kahaani 2: Durga Rani Singh
desc: When her disabled daughter is kidnapped, Vidya attempts to save her, but a car knocks her off. When the police get involved in the case, Vidya's mysterious past is revealed.

title: Mission Istanbul
desc: Vikas, an ambitious journalist, agrees to work for Al Johara. When his friend is killed while investigating a terror camp, Vikas discovers a sinister link between his employers and the terrorists.

title: Yes Boss
desc: Rahul's boss, Siddharth, is a womaniser who exploits Rahul into helping him win over Seema. However, Rahul ends up falling for Seema and is torn between his career aspirations and her.

title: Khoonkhaar
desc: Gagan, a brave young man, is unable to be with Sweety, his true love, due to her parents' disapproval of him. However, he vows to protect her after unknowingly saving her from gangsters.

title: Prem Ratan Dhan Payo
desc: Prem, who looks like Prince Yuvraj Vijay Singh, replaces him just before Vijay is to be crowned king. Although Vijay is engaged to Princess Maithili, she falls in love with Prem.

title: Jai Ho
desc: A former Indian military officer devises a unique plan to promote social responsibility amongst apathetic civilians. The masses embrace his initiative, but he must confront a potent political family.

title: Bhairavakona
desc: After committing a robbery, Basava and his companion, John, run into Agraharam Geetha, a stranger, and the trio end up in Bhairavakona, a village shrouded in mystery.
